note: Closes the learning loop: every Engineering Rule / watched pattern must make a falsifiable prediction about the next experiment. A resolved prediction feeds back into RuleSupport (confirmed → support, refuted → contradict). This is what makes the model say 'what will happen if...', not only explain the past.

prediction_shape.measurable_outcome: the axis/observation that confirms or refutes it

predictions.prediction: If recoverability-after-remix stays high, viscosity drift will NOT predict failure.
predictions.measurable_outcome: across batches: high recoverability + high viscosity-drift still pass; failure tracks recoverability, not drift
predictions.note: Open prediction tied to the watched pattern WP-001 — testing it is how that pattern earns (or loses) the right to become a Mechanism Candidate.
